title: centaurea attica subsp. asperula
intro: Centaurea attica subsp. asperula, commonly known as Mountain Cornflower or Wild Cornflower, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Asteraceae family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can help in soothing digestive issues, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to interact with the body's physiological processes, exerting effects on the cardiovascular, nervous, and immune systems, while also exhibiting potential anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Centaurea attica subsp. asperula include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and therapeutic actions.
